summary: The F-16's nine weapon stations: wingtip missile rails, six under the wings, the centreline

stations.name: left wingtip
stations.note: its place estimated on hangar's design of the F-16C: its spanwise station judged from the type's layout (not measured), a store's CG 40 % of the local chord aft of the leading edge and 0.6 m below the wing (the centreline's 0.4 m aft of the CG and 1.3 m below it); its limit the figure commonly quoted, unconfirmed by a primary source: engineering assumptions
